items.title: Explicit Buium-Coleman bounds for the reduction and size of the Zilber-Pink locus of curves in abelian varieties
items.author: Netan Dogra; Sudip Pandit
items.difficulty_reason: The quantitative unlikely-intersection theorem combines arithmetic jet/prolongation spaces, Kummer and Zariski-closure structure, separate supersingular and nonsupersingular finiteness arguments, Buium degree estimates and Coleman/Betts zero-count bounds on residue discs. It retains the original generating-curve, genus/prime, ample bundle and property-star hypotheses, complete formulas and all supporting arguments; this is independent of the old preliminary finite_2 proposition.

primary.label: complete original main theorem: both reduction bounds and property-star total bound

proof_spans.label: complete original jet-space/prolongation, Zariski closure, supersingular and ordinary cases, degree estimates, Coleman residue discs and ramified arguments

contexts.label: original p-adic base ring, generating curve, Zilber-Pink locus and property-star hypotheses
original quantitative interpretation and related finiteness statements
